portInfo.description: Ocean Cay is MSC Cruises’ exclusive Bahamas private island, restored from a former sand-excavation site into a marketed marine reserve with beaches, spa, food trucks/bars, cabanas and conservation programming. The MSC destination FAQ states ships berth directly at the quay next to the Welcome Centre in Ocean Village, so guests walk ashore without tenders, may return to the ship at any time during the call, and navigate by signed paths (about twenty minutes to the far side of the ~95-acre island). Eight named beaches (including North/South lagoon beaches, Sunset Beach, Lighthouse Bay beside the ~100-foot lighthouse, and Yacht Club-only Ocean House Beach) plus Seakers Food Court, Springer’s and Lighthouse bars, and the MSC Foundation Super Coral / Mission Blue Hope Spot story are on the same destination materials. Quay LOA/door coordinates are not published as WGS84 on the page used — keep pins null.
